name: Volibear
notes: Opens with Stormbringer (R) at t=0 since its cooldown (110-160s) far exceeds any fight length, so it casts only once; Volibear's 1 s dash means the impact damage lands at t=1s.
Casts Sky Splitter (E) immediately after, since its 16s cooldown also allows only one cast in most fight lengths and its bolt lands 2 s after the cast.

Thundering Smash (Q) is cast whenever off cooldown; it deals no damage itself but arms Volibear's next basic attack with bonus physical damage, a stun, and a free extra attack (modeled as a windup-only reset instead of the normal attack period), and its cooldown starts only once that attack lands (post-effect).

Frenzied Maul (W) is cast on cooldown (5s); its 0.25s cast time delays the strike, which deals the higher 'Wounded bite' damage whenever the target's 8s Wounded mark (applied by the previous cast) is still active - which it always is after the opening cast, since W's cooldown is shorter than the mark's duration.

Between ability casts Volibear basic-attacks continuously; each basic attack or ability hit generates a stack of The Relentless Storm, and only the hit that brings the stack count from 4 to 5 gets the Lightning Claws bonus magic damage - since stacks stay capped at 5 for the rest of a continuous fight, this proc effectively fires only once.
Volibear starts the fight with 0 stacks of The Relentless Storm (cold); the dossier flags the starting stack count as an open question and this is the simplest, most common baseline reading.
Where the wiki's cooldown for Thundering Smash ([12, 11.5, 11, 10.5, 10]) disagrees with the bin's ddragon value ([14, 13, 12, 11, 10]), the wiki's number is used, per instructions.
Where the wiki's Lightning Claws per-level base damage disagrees with the bin's byLevelL array, the wiki's derived formula is used.

Frenzied Maul's forced 'bite' is modeled as a single ability-damage instance per cast (either the base strike or the empowered bite, never both), since the wiki describes the bite as replacing the base strike ('instead') rather than adding a separate basic attack.
Mana costs are not modeled; nothing in this rotation would meaningfully run out of mana within a 15 s fight at level 16.
Sky Splitter's target-max-health damage term and Frenzied Maul's bonus-AD bite multiplier are evaluated with the stats current at the moment each hit lands.
